name: Mist corridor west
purpose: A short fork: on the right a steaming door with a temperature board leads into the Steam Grotto; straight ahead the corridor pool pours over a polished lip and the Mist Steps fall away in sheets of water toward Kawagiri's glow 20 m below.

ceiling_profile.note: Carved basalt barrel, 2.4 m at the springing and 3.0 m at the crown: the compressed register of B1.

hero.note: Built as the top-step nosing of the Mist Steps (stair generator + w_mist_steps sheet), so no proxy is placed here; it must not obstruct the stair head.
hero.why: The corridor ends in a falling view: the whole pool slides over a polished basalt lip onto the first flight of the Mist Steps, mist pours down with it and the restaurant's warm (and faintly neon) glow rises from below. Lit from the flanking toro and from under the sheet, it is the brightest thing straight ahead from the junction.

anchored.why: Temperature board on the south wall facing the steam door (concept 16 boards).
NW corner of the landing, off the walk line, so the head is framed by two toro.
Single silhouette on the north kerb between the steam door and the junction.
South-kerb corner by the stair head: frames the lip from the side instead of blocking the view down.
Lanterns on the grotto door posts at 1.8 m (replace the floor pair).

Ankle niches: two mid-corridor pools; the lip owns the far end.

water.note: Drains west over the spill lip down the Mist Steps (w_mist_steps).
First sheet: lip to the first landing; the stair generator continues it.

sightlines.see: Straight ahead the lit spill lip and the void of the stair with mist pouring down; steam and lantern glow from the grotto door on the right.
Leaving the grotto: the stair head to the right (west), the junction bell's glow to the left (east).
Down flight 1: water sheets on every step, landing lanterns, and a warm amber-and-magenta haze from Kawagiri far below.

concept.match: Corridor mood: stones curving left to a glowing lip where the mist drops away; steam door with noren and temperature board on the right; ankle lanterns doubled in the water.

lights.why: Warm under-sheet glow at the lip: the hero light (the lip itself is the stair's top nosing).
Warm glow part-way down flight 1 so the descent reads as steps falling toward Kawagiri.

mood.palette: amber, teal, black basalt; faint magenta haze rising from Kawagiri far below (neon light only, no neon objects on B1)
mood.mist: Knee-high (0.4 m) layer over the whole pool, densest at the walls, thinning over the stones. Pours over the lip down the steps; puffs of white steam at the grotto door.

waivers.reason: The lip is the top-step nosing of the Mist Steps (borrowed_from mist_steps; built by the stair generator), so no hero proxy is placed; it is centre-frame from the entry camera.

light_notes: Warm light behind the falling sheet at the stair head (part of the mist_steps spill; no proxy).
conventions: anchored/hero 'at' = object centre on its floor; facing_deg = bearing of the asset's front (+Y). Extra keys beyond SCHEMA.md: spurs, segments, implied portals, bed_z/top_z, stagger/groups on lights, footprint on still water.
